headline: PBI takes friend into custody over ex-airman's death
summary: A motorcycle was recovered near the Turag River as investigators probe the death of former Flight Lieutenant Tahsif Souri.
details: The Police Bureau of Investigation (PBI) has launched a shadow investigation into the death of former Air Force Flight Lieutenant Tahsif Souri, alongside the Naval Police's ongoing probe.

As part of the investigation, PBI recovered a motorcycle from the Mazar slum area, approximately 50 yards from the Turag River in Tongi. Authorities are currently verifying if the bike belongs to Tahsif.
Ahmed Shahriyar Reza Deep, described as a 'junior friend' of Tahsif, was taken into custody by the PBI on Thursday night for questioning.
Tahsif's body was recovered from the Turag River in Tongi last Wednesday afternoon after he had been missing since the previous day.
Tahsif's father, Enayetul Karim, has alleged that his son was murdered, speaking to reporters in front of the morgue on Thursday.
caption:
A former Air Force officer's friend is in custody and a motorcycle has been recovered as PBI probes a suspected murder.

The Police Bureau of Investigation (PBI) has launched a shadow investigation into the death of former Air Force Flight Lieutenant Tahsif Souri, alongside the Naval Police's ongoing probe.

As part of the investigation, PBI recovered a motorcycle from the Mazar slum area, approximately 50 yards from the Turag River in Tongi. Authorities are currently verifying if the bike belongs to Tahsif.

Ahmed Shahriyar Reza Deep, described as a 'junior friend' of Tahsif, was taken into custody by the PBI on Thursday night for questioning.

Tahsif's body was recovered from the Turag River in Tongi last Wednesday afternoon after he had been missing since the previous day.

Tahsif's father, Enayetul Karim, has alleged that his son was murdered, speaking to reporters in front of the morgue on Thursday.

headline_marked: 1 killed, 2 injured in [[septic tank explosion in Gazipur]]
headline: 1 killed, 2 injured in septic tank explosion in Gazipur
summary: A garment worker died on the spot after a septic tank exploded at an under-construction building in Naojor, Gazipur city.
details: A septic tank exploded at a three-storey under-construction building in Naojor, Gazipur city, on Friday morning around 7:15 am.
The deceased, identified as Sakib, a garment worker from Bauphal Upazila in Patuakhali district, was killed on the spot.
Two other people were injured in the blast, who were rescued and taken to Shaheed Tajuddin Ahmad Medical College Hospital.
According to the Gazipur Chowrasta Modern Fire Service, two rooms had been built over the septic tank on the ground floor and rented out to workers.
The explosion damaged the doors and windows of the rooms. Sakib's body was handed over to Basan Police Station.
Police suspect the blast was caused by an accumulation of gas inside the septic tank.
caption:
A garment worker was killed on the spot after a septic tank exploded under his room in Gazipur.

A septic tank exploded at a three-storey under-construction building in Naojor, Gazipur city, on Friday morning around 7:15 am.

The deceased, identified as Sakib, a garment worker from Bauphal Upazila in Patuakhali district, was killed on the spot.

Two other people were injured in the blast, who were rescued and taken to Shaheed Tajuddin Ahmad Medical College Hospital.

According to the Gazipur Chowrasta Modern Fire Service, two rooms had been built over the septic tank on the ground floor and rented out to workers.

The explosion damaged the doors and windows of the rooms. Sakib's body was handed over to Basan Police Station.

Police suspect the blast was caused by an accumulation of gas inside the septic tank.
